snippet.title: Northgard Battlegrounds | Gameplay Overview | OPEN BETA JULY 9
snippet.description:
Play the Open Beta on July 9 during Steam Tacticon!

Discover Northgard Battlegrounds in this brand-new gameplay overview presented by John from Funday Games.

Learn how city-building, Fate Cards, clan abilities, and asynchronous PvP combine to create a fresh take on the auto-battler genre.

---------------------------------

Wishlist Northgard Battlegrounds on Steam and be ready to join the battle when the Open Beta begins! https://shiro.li/vuBKts

---------------------------------
